title: Cold Pack Quantity Pricing on Riverbend's Take-Home Price List — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
The cold pack (code A9273 under revenue code 0274), dispensed on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) and valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is valued at its charges multiplied by its quantity share, which follows the quantity dispensed (its billed units):

| Cold-pack units dispensed | Quantity share |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0.55 |
| 2 to 3 | 0.7 |
| a single unit | 1 |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical charges of 100.00)**
- 3 units → 70.00; 4 units → 55.00.
- 1 unit → 100.00; 2 units → 70.00.
